title: Add the ability to set hierarchy of panels so that a panel can always overlap another panel
line: A vertical panel can now be set to take the screen corners, with horizontal panels making room for it.
explanation: Panels don't overlap on Wayland: KWin reserves the panels' space one after the other, and since 2025 it always does horizontal panels first, so a top or bottom panel always gets the screen corners and a vertical panel always starts below it. Nothing let a panel ask otherwise. Layer surfaces can now set an exclusive zone priority through the plasma-shell protocol, and KWin reserves higher priorities first; a vertical panel set to "Fill height" gets a "Screen corners: Take over from horizontal panels" checkbox, which only sets that priority, so KWin itself gives it the corners.

commits.message:
plasma-shell: add set_exclusive_zone_priority

Where the exclusive zones of two layer surfaces meet, like a screen
corner shared by a horizontal and a vertical panel, only the compositor
decided who got it. The new request lets a surface ask to go first.

BUG: 520053

layershellv1integration: reserve exclusive zones by priority first

Horizontal panels always reserved their space first, so a vertical panel
could never take the screen corners. Layer surfaces can now set a
priority with org_kde_plasma_surface, and higher ones go first.

BUG: 520053

plasmashellwaylandintegration: add setExclusiveZonePriority

A layer shell window had no way to ask the compositor to reserve its
exclusive zone before the others. This wraps the new plasma-shell
request, which lets a vertical panel take the screen corners.

BUG: 520053

shell: let a vertical panel take the screen corners

Horizontal panels always took the screen corners, so a vertical panel
could never reach the top or bottom of the screen. A vertical panel that
fills its edge can now ask KWin to reserve its space before them.

BUG: 520053

panel config: add an option for a vertical panel to take the corners

There was no way to choose which panel takes the screen corners when a
vertical and a horizontal panel meet. Vertical panels that fill their
edge now get a "Screen corners" checkbox in the panel settings.

BUG: 520053

From c6db119dae293acc7c54e93951a1c61795faaffa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 21:04:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] panel config: add an option for a vertical panel to take the
 corners

There was no way to choose which panel takes the screen corners when a
vertical and a horizontal panel meet. Vertical panels that fill their
edge now get a "Screen corners" checkbox in the panel settings.

BUG: 520053
---
 .../configuration/PanelConfiguration.qml         | 16 +++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 15 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/PanelConfiguration.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/PanelConfiguration.qml
index cb897a1f04..3a63cf8929 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/PanelConfiguration.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/configuration/PanelConfiguration.qml
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PC3
 import org.kde.plasma.shell
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols
+import org.kde.kwindowsystem
 import "panelconfiguration"
 
 ColumnLayout {
@@ -624,7 +625,6 @@ ColumnLayout {
         Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
         rowSpacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
         columnSpacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
-        rows: 2
         columns: 2
 
         PC3.Label {
@@ -684,6 +684,20 @@ ColumnLayout {
                 plasmoid.globalShortcut = button.keySequence
             }
         }
+
+        PC3.Label {
+            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight
+            visible: coversCornersCheckBox.visible
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@label:checkbox", "Screen corners:")
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        }
+        PC3.CheckBox {
+            id: coversCornersCheckBox
+            visible: KWindowSystem.isPlatformWayland && dialogRoot.vertical && panel.lengthMode === Panel.FillAvailable
+            text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@option:check horizontal panels on the same screen make room for this vertical panel", "Take over from horizontal panels")
+            checked: panel.coversCorners
+            onToggled: panel.coversCorners = checked
+        }
     }
 
     PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
-- 
2.53.0

From f23f95541ae18be5740243923c76201139399be7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 03:29:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-shell: add set_exclusive_zone_priority

Where the exclusive zones of two layer surfaces meet, like a screen
corner shared by a horizontal and a vertical panel, only the compositor
decided who got it. The new request lets a surface ask to go first.

BUG: 520053
---
 src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml | 20 ++++++++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 18 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
index baca1af..da0b022 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="9">
     <description summary="create shell windows and helpers">
       This interface is used by KF5 powered Wayland shells to communicate with
       the compositor and can only be bound one time.
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="9">
     <description summary="metadata interface">
       An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for
       implementations that provide the shell user interface.
@@ -304,5 +304,21 @@
         cursor position. Has to be called before attaching any buffer to this surface.
       </description>
     </request>
+
+    <request name="set_exclusive_zone_priority" since="9">
+      <description summary="set the order in which exclusive zones are reserved">
+        Only meaningful for surfaces with the zwlr_layer_surface_v1 role.
+
+        Within a layer, the compositor reserves the exclusive zones of surfaces
+        with a higher priority first. Where the exclusive zones of two surfaces
+        would meet, for example in a screen corner shared by a horizontal and a
+        vertical panel, the surface with the higher priority takes that space
+        and the other one is made to avoid it.
+
+        Surfaces with the same priority are ordered by the compositor. The
+        default priority is 0.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="priority" type="int" summary="the exclusive zone priority"/>
+    </request>
   </interface>
 </protocol>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the top panel always takes the corner, the left panel starts below it
Option on: the left panel spans the full height, the top panel starts after it
Master: left panel settings, no way to choose
New "Screen corners" checkbox for vertical panels that fill their edge

review.text: Good multi-repo architecture that puts exclusive-zone corner priority in KWin via org_kde_plasma_surface.set_exclusive_zone_priority rather than client-side margin hacks, with thorough live verification. A few edge cases and metadata details need cleanup before MR: the settings checkbox is shown for non-Always-Visible vertical panels where it only appears to work in Edit Mode, expectedPosition() misses non-FillAvailable horizontal panels, KWin needs destruction handling and an autotest for the new priority, and prerequisite commits should use CCBUG.
changes: In plasma-desktop (PanelConfiguration.qml) and plasma-workspace (PanelView::updateLayerWindow() / setVisibilityMode()), gate both checkbox visibility and takesCorners on visibilityMode == NormalPanel so Auto-hide, Dodge-windows, and Windows-go-below vertical panels do not expose a checkbox that only takes effect temporarily in Edit Mode.

In plasma-workspace (PanelView::expectedPosition()), null-check panel->m_layerWindow and also adjust horizontal panels that are not FillAvailable (e.g. left-aligned or centered FitContent/Custom panels) so their popups do not open over a corner-taking left panel.

In kwin (src/wayland_server.cpp / layershellv1integration), guard workspace() (or connect in LayerShellV1Integration), schedule a rearrange if a PlasmaShellSurfaceInterface with non-zero priority is destroyed, and add an autotest in layershellv1window_test.cpp covering set_exclusive_zone_priority.

Change BUG: 520053 to CCBUG: 520053 on the four prerequisite commits (plasma-wayland-protocols, kwin, libplasma, plasma-workspace) and keep BUG: 520053 only on the final user-facing plasma-desktop commit so Bugzilla is not closed prematurely.
